learning.why: मैडम ने सेक्टर और सेगमेंट का फर्क दोबारा समझाया—सेक्टर में दो radii और आर्क, सेगमेंट में कॉर्ड और आर्क। पीज़ा और चाकू के कट की मिसाल से मेरे दिमाग में बैठ गया।
मैडम ने सीधा बता दिया कि सेक्टर में radii होती हैं, सेगमेंट में chord। बार-बार सुनके अब कन्फ्यूज़न खतम।
teacher explained that every diameter works as a fold line
realised circle can be folded along any diameter, not just 4

end.summary:
Named radius, diameter and chord using circle diagrams.
Initially mixed up sector and segment; later corrected the definitions using pizza-slice examples.
Identified minor and major segments.
Initially answered four lines of symmetry, then recognised that every diameter gives a line of symmetry.
Rotation symmetry angle remained unresolved; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised circle parts and symmetry with Dev, using familiar pizza-slice examples to distinguish a sector from a segment. Dev corrected the sector/segment mix-up later in the lesson and explained minor and major segments. The number of lines of symmetry was still unsettled by the end. At home, ask Dev to label a circle and explain why a sector uses two radii and an arc, while a segment uses a chord and an arc.
